items.headline: A brown suede adidas Gazelle from two Japanese labels
items.caption: ÉDIFICE and IÉNA make a flat-soled Gazelle Lo Pro.
body: Rich brown suede with gold branding.
They've done the Tokyo and long-tongue Samba before.
How to wear it: with cream trousers and a navy knit.

items.headline: Supreme is now official merch maker for New York City
items.caption: The brand signed a licensing deal with the city government.
body: Supreme will make city-official NYC merchandise.
Highsnobiety calls it Supreme's greatest collab.
How to wear it: one logo piece, everything else plain.

items.headline: A Lola Bunny Air Jordan 3 for Space Jam's 30th
items.caption: Clean white leather with soft pink fades.
body: Lola Bunny appears on the insoles.
It follows a Bugs Bunny pair.
How to wear it: with light denim to let the pink pop.

items.headline: James Bond is an adidas guy
items.caption: Daniel Craig wore Gazelles in 2012's Skyfall.
body: The hunt for the next Bond continues.
GQ says whoever gets the role needs good sneakers too.
How to wear it: Gazelles with a slim suit, no socks showing.

items.headline: GQ Men of the Year 2026 is on 17 November
items.caption: The 29th edition of Britain's big menswear night.
body: It celebrates the year's top names in culture.
It takes place in London.
Style lesson: black tie, done properly.

items.headline: The 4 coats every man needs, according to Tom Hardy
items.caption: From Bane's shearling to Alfie Solomons' black overcoat.
body: Esquire picks his best outerwear moments.
And shows how to recreate each.
How to wear it: one shearling, one overcoat, done.

items.headline: Your guide to the Rolex Daytona
items.caption: The world's most wanted watch, and how to buy one.
body: A steel Daytona now sells for about £11,000 over list price.
Four Daytonas fetched £37.3 million at one charity auction.
Style lesson: buy the watch you'll actually wear.

items.headline: Tom Hardy's 'Inception' wardrobe still holds up
items.caption: Prints, great trousers and a mystery vintage watch.
body: Esquire revisits his Eames look 16 years on.
It's relaxed but sharp.
How to wear it: a printed shirt with tailored trousers.

items.headline: Vacheron's Fiftysix goes grey
items.caption: A new grey two-tone dial and a complete calendar model.
body: Both have 40mm steel cases.
The self-winding one is Vacheron's most affordable watch.
Style lesson: grey goes with everything.

items.headline: Albishorn's second watch: the Voisin Aérosport
items.caption: A small brand's possible breakout release.
body: Albishorn is run by chronograph collector Sébastien Chaulmontet.
Its first model was an affordable, clever chronograph.
Style lesson: small brands often have the best ideas.

items.headline: Volcanic gas on Mars could point to life
items.caption: Scientists found hydrogen chloride seeping from Martian volcanic rifts.
body: It suggests Mars is sleeping, not geologically dead.
Magma meeting groundwater could create warm, habitable spots.

items.headline: Strangers raised $76,000 for a struggling caregiver
items.caption: A doorbell video of a pizza delivery went viral.
body: Suzanna Metcalf cares for her 82-year-old mother.
The money helps support her.

items.headline: Boy with autism found safe after 3 days missing
items.caption: Six-year-old Roman Heilman walked out of the bushes with a little dog.
body: A horse-trail rider spotted him in Kentucky.
He was singing 'Old McDonald'.
